limits: Store read fidelity, content immutability, current auth, runtime checks and worker correctness are explicit external assumptions.
Definition extraction, Java defensive copies, exact real heap accounting, thread-safety, backup/restore invalidation and SQLeanParser/SQL correctness are not proved.
Preview model is non-authoritative and cannot mutate head/history/receipts; it does not model accepted commit, evidence or a general store system.
The model uses an abstract immutable Store and StoreExtends relation; real DB restoration, ownership changes or mutations require invalidation or disablement.
